cross_product_finding: This page surfaces the one genuine 'edition-shaped' concept found in Couchbase Lite so far: an Enterprise/Community split, gating Predictive Query. Structurally this echoes server/'s edition:enterprise gate (same phrase, same marketing URL, https://www.couchbase.com/products/editions), but it is applied to an entirely different feature - client-side ML inference over local documents - with no server cluster, no index-manage privilege, and no Capella billing/support-plan gate involved. Per batch instructions we minted a separate cbl:enterprise-edition concept rather than reusing server/'s edition:enterprise, since the licensing boundary is drawn around a disjoint feature set even though the brand name is identical; a coordinator pass should decide whether these editions are actually the same cross-product SKU (same purchase unlocks both) or coincidentally-named per-product tiers.
